{{Quote|The Ryndellia system&hellip; near Naboo. Isn't that where our medical base is?|Anakin Skywalker|audio=RyndelliaSystemNearNaboo-SoM.flac|<ref name="som" />}}
The '''Kaliida Shoals Medical Center''' was a [[Haven-class medical station/Legends|''Haven''-class medical station]] and the first of its kind to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located near the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Kaliida_shoals_command_center.png|thumb|left|250px|The command center of Kaliida Shoals]]
The Kaliida Shoals Medical Center was located near [[Kaliida Shoals/Legends|Kaliida Shoals]],<ref name="FF18">{{FactFile2014|18|YWI 3-4|BTL-B Y-wing Starfighter}}</ref> in the [[Ryndellia system/Legends|Ryndellia system]].<ref name="som" /> The space station was powered by a reactor slung underneath the main structure of the station. The control hub was located in a tower at the top of the structure, while the eight main medical bays,<ref name="db" /> filled with [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]], covered much of the interior.<ref name="som" /> Each medical station had a vertical gap for accommodating a Republic [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|medical frigate]].<ref name="db" /> The station was painted in the characteristic red stripes of other Republic vessels.<ref name="som" />

==History==
{{Quote|Even if we had the transports, it is not possible to evacuate all of our wounded in time.''"<br />"''You must try. You won't stand a chance against that battleship.|Nala Se and Admiral Wullf Yularen|audio=YouMustTry-SoM.flac|<ref name="som" />}}
The station began as a merchant hub in the [[Enarc system/Legends|Enarc system]]. At some point before the war, it was abandoned as a derelict station, and at the beginning of hostilities was bought by the Republic. It was refurbished with standardized habitation modules and medical facilities and towed by [[Republic tugboat/Legends|interstellar tugs]]<ref name="db" /> to the Ryndellia system, near the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], where it served as a medical center. The station received injured [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], who were treated by the staff, which included the empathic [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] doctor [[Nala Se/Legends|Nala Se]].<ref name="som" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the station fell under the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|assault]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]' forces, however [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]] foiled the attack.<ref name="som" /> This marked one of the earliest deployments of the new [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]].<ref name="DB:YWS">{{DB|starship|ywingstarfighter|Y-wing starfighter}}</ref> At the time of the attack, the station was caring for some 60,000 wounded clones.<ref name="db" />
